guidedrailways.ponder.shared.bogey_place: Choose a bogey style in its selection menu, then R-Click straight or curved track with the bogey item
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.bogey_physi: Placement creates a physical bogey immediately; no assembly at the controls is needed
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.bogey_build: Build on the top mount and glue together the blocks that should move as one carriage; bogeys can also attach beneath an existing physical body
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.bogey_power: Supply rotational power through the top of the mount to drive the wheelset
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.bogey_drive: Input RPM determines the available target speed; load affects stress demand and acceleration
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.bogey_rerai: R-Click with a Wrench to toggle brakes; when off track, stop, select the carriage with the Wrench, then R-Click a target track with enough room
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.bogey_remov: Sneak-R-Click with a Wrench to remove the entire bogey; an ordinary R-Click does not remove it
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_in: Place the controls on a physical carriage; only the first-placed controls in a consist manage power for the whole train
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_en: First R-Click the controls to enter driving mode; the camera and crosshair remain free
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_le: Once driving, aim at the controls, hold right-click and drag vertically to adjust the traction and brake notch
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_st: Movement left/right selects a junction branch; otherwise the default branch is used and coupled carriages follow the leader; Esc leaves without changing the notch
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_br: Left-click while driving to apply emergency braking immediately
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_re: Once stopped, aim at the controls and hold right-click for about a second to reset emergency braking, then set the lever again
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_se: Sneak-R-Click to open settings and change the train name or each traction notch's target speed
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_sc: R-Click the controls with a Schedule to store it and start running it; insert it while stopped and provide power for departure
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.controls_ob: During a running Schedule, R-Click only observes it; choose Take Control in settings to switch to manual driving
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_pa: Use a Rail Docking Connector on both the carriage and the world; face them toward each other and align them at the stopping position
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_se: R-Click the world connector with a Wrench to select it first
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_bi: Then R-Click the destination station with the Wrench to bind it; selecting and clicking the same station again unlinks it
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_ad: Associate a mailbox with this station and set its address; the connector reads the station's mailbox addresses rather than replacing the mailbox
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_st: Run a Fetch or Deliver Packages Schedule from the controls; the train must stop at the bound station before automatic docking is requested
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_lo: Wait for both ends to pair and lock; packages are then exchanged according to task direction and matching addresses
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_ca: Connect carriage storage to the connector with real funnels, chutes or other transfer devices; it does not remotely access every chest on the train
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_in: R-Click a connector with an empty hand to inspect its linked station, mailbox addresses and docking status
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.transfer_re: After the task finishes, docking is released before departure; external redstone power must also be removed to allow release
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_in: Install an Electro Energetics pantograph and physical train controls on the carriage; disconnect rotational input at the mount when testing electric-only traction
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_wi: Place catenary holders above the track, then R-Click them in sequence with a wire spool to connect the overhead line
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_su: Connect the catenary to a DC supply circuit and a Ground Rod; supply voltage must meet the train minimum configured in Electro Energetics
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_co: R-Click the pantograph with an empty hand to raise or lower it; it must contact an energized overhead line, and being raised alone does not mean power is available
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_en: First R-Click the controls to enter manual driving; if a Schedule is running, choose Take Control in settings
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_dr: Aim at the controls, hold right-click and move the lever into a traction notch; the controls distribute received electrical power across the physical train's bogeys
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_li: A traction notch sets a target speed; voltage, available power and load still limit acceleration, so full traction does not guarantee reaching the target
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_lo: Lowering the pantograph or leaving energized catenary removes electric traction; if the train will not move, check contact, voltage, brakes and traction notch
guidedrailways.ponder.shared.electric_br: Braking remains available without electrical supply; left-click while driving for emergency braking, then hold right-click on the controls for about a second once stopped to reset it
guidedrailways.status.station_gone: The station this train was stopped at has been removed
